title: Silence on the Final Page
text:
Many readers consider the short story a demanding form. Because the writer has few pages to work with, every word must serve a purpose. In a good story, a single detail, such as an unopened letter on a table, can suggest a whole history of unspoken regret. The reader is asked to fill in the gaps.

Authors use these techniques to create tension without stating it directly. In the story discussed in class, the narrator never explains why the brother stopped speaking to the family. Instead, the reader notices how he avoids the kitchen and leaves the room whenever his name is mentioned. By the final page, the silence says more than dialogue could.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what must every word in a short story do?
According to the second paragraph, what does the narrator never explain?
options: Why the brother stopped speaking to the family

questions.text: What can the reader most reasonably infer about the brother's behavior?
options: He is trying to avoid something painful connected to the family
He has moved to another country
He does not know that the family is talking about him
He enjoys cooking in the kitchen

questions.text: Why does the author let the silence say more than dialogue could?
options: To give the reader more dialogue to read
To create tension and let the reader draw conclusions
To explain the brother's past in detail
To show that the family has no connection to the story

vocabulary.definition: requiring great effort, skill or attention
felt or understood but not said out loud
a feeling of nervous strain or suspense
keeps away from someone or something

paragraph_translations: Muchos lectores consideran que el cuento corto es una forma exigente. Como el escritor tiene pocas páginas para trabajar, cada palabra debe cumplir un propósito. En un buen cuento, un solo detalle, como una carta sin abrir sobre una mesa, puede sugerir toda una historia de arrepentimiento no expresado. Se pide al lector que llene los vacíos.

Los autores usan estas técnicas para crear tensión sin mencionarla directamente. En el cuento que se analizó en clase, el narrador nunca explica por qué el hermano dejó de hablar con la familia. En cambio, el lector nota cómo él evita la cocina y sale de la habitación cada vez que se menciona su nombre. Hacia la última página, el silencio dice más de lo que podría decir un diálogo.
